subject: general
question: Which Ministry organised the National Conference on 'Institutional Mediation: An Effective Framework for Dispute Resolution' on 14 June 2025 at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ministry of Law and Justice**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• The **Ministry of Law and Justice** organized the National Conference on 'Institutional Mediation: An Effective Framework for Dispute Resolution' on **14 June 2025** at Bharat Mandapam, New Delhi.
 
• The conference emphasized the importance of mediation as a key tool for alternative dispute resolution (ADR) and reducing the burden on traditional courts.
 
• The event also focused on institutionalizing mediation practices across sectors and creating a robust legal framework for its implementation.
 
• The Ministry of Law and Justice is responsible for managing legal affairs, legislative activities, and judicial reforms in the country, including introducing innovative dispute resolution mechanisms.
 
• This initiative aligns with the government's efforts to promote faster, cost-effective, and amicable resolution of disputes.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ministry of External Affairs:**

 
 
• It is responsible for managing India's foreign relations and diplomatic affairs.
 
• The Ministry oversees India's representation in international organizations, consular services, and bilateral and multilateral negotiations.
 
• It plays a significant role in promoting India's global presence and securing economic, strategic, and cultural interests abroad.
 
 
 
• **Home Ministry:**
 
 
• The Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) is responsible for internal security, law and order, and governance of Union Territories.
 
• It supervises paramilitary forces, disaster management, and border security.
 
• It is also responsible for counter-terrorism strategies and handling issues related to citizenship, fundamental rights, and national integration.
 
 
 
• **Ministry of Defence:**
 
 
• This Ministry is tasked with ensuring national security and the operational readiness of the armed forces.
 
• It oversees the Indian Army, Navy, Air Force, and Coast Guard.
 
• The Ministry also manages defense production, procurement, research, and development to strengthen India's defense capabilities.
